title: Cascadia: A Control-Plane-Free Alternative to Hyperconverged AI Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2609.38697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Cascadia, a system for serving large language models on fleets of commodity Intel AIPCs using their CPU, integrated-GPU, and NPU resources. Every node embeds ingress, scheduling, and execution; inference requests require no dedicated routing control plane. Nodes join a libp2p QUIC mesh using CA-issued ed25519 admission certificates, gossip signed capabilities, exchange live load over direct peer streams, and route OpenAI-compatible requests to eligible peers. An operator-run certificate authority handles admission and fleet management outside the inference path. Three serving modes share one interface: whole-model execution on one node, load-balanced replicas, and pipeline-sharded chains using the compilation and speculative decoding mechanism of our companion paper. translated_title: Cascadia：一种无控制平面的超融合AI基础设施替代方案
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Cascadia，这是一个在商用Intel AIPC集群上利用其CPU、集成GPU和NPU资源来服务大语言模型的系统。每个节点都内嵌了入口、调度和执行功能，推理请求无需专用的路由控制平面。节点使用CA签发的ed25519准入证书加入libp2p QUIC网状网络，通过gossip协议传播签名的能力信息，通过直接点对点流交换实时负载，并将兼容OpenAI的请求路由到符合条件的对等节点。由运营者运行的证书权威机构在推理路径之外处理准入和集群管理。三种服务模式共享一个统一接口：单节点全模型执行、负载均衡副本，以及使用我们配套论文中编译与投机解码机制的流水线分片链。可选的KV缓存迁移功能可在路由切换后重用兼容的对话前缀，未命中时进行冷重计算。签名响应回执和哈希链……
tldr: Cascadia提出了一种无控制平面的去中心化AI推理基础设施，让每个商用Intel AIPC节点内嵌入口、调度与执行功能，通过libp2p QUIC对等网络自组织协调，支持全模型、负载均衡副本和流水线分片三种服务模式来服务大语言模型。
en_tdlr: Cascadia is a control-plane-free system for serving LLMs on fleets of commodity Intel AIPCs, where every node embeds ingress, scheduling, and execution within a libp2p QUIC peer-to-peer mesh, supporting whole-model, load-balanced replica, and pipeline-sharded serving modes.
